content: The ZI implementation is described as follows: Before the daily news sequence is processed by the text temporal layer (described in itm:newstclayer) we input a 0 vector for all time steps with missing news and leave the news encoding unchanged otherwise. This step is called zero imputation. In addition, we concatenate feature-wise an indicator vector with value 1 for all vectors with zero imputation and 0 for the days with news.
